prTitle: feat: lease-ledger — roster leases with atomic acquisition and reaping

criteria.check: AC1 lease-ledger: acquires a lease and reports it held
AC2 lease-ledger: refuses to acquire a role already held by another run
AC3 lease-ledger: allows a different run to take a role once the first lease expires
AC4 lease-ledger: renews a held lease and extends it from the renewal moment
AC5 lease-ledger: refuses to renew an expired or unknown lease
AC6 lease-ledger: releases a lease and frees every role it held
AC7 lease-ledger: reaping releases every expired lease and leaves live ones alone
AC8 lease-ledger: reaping is idempotent and reports nothing on a second pass
AC9 lease-ledger: an acquisition that fails partway frees every role it had taken
AC10 lease-ledger: a run may hold only one lease at a time
AC11 lease-ledger: heldRoles is sorted ascending and excludes expired leases
AC12 lease-ledger: snapshot reports every live lease, sorted by runId, without exposing internals
AC14 lease-ledger: release and reap are consistent: a reaped run cannot be renewed or released twice

oracleAccess.note: The agent can read acceptance/ and run `npm run acceptance`. A pass therefore means "converged against a visible oracle", not "was right without checking".
